Usage: gacli admin custom-metrics create [options]

Create a custom metric

Options:
  --parameter-name <parameterName>  Event parameter name
  --display-name <displayName>      Display name
  --description <description>       Description of the custom metric
  --scope <scope>                   Metric scope (EVENT)
  --measurement-unit <unit>         Measurement unit (STANDARD, CURRENCY, FEET,
                                    METERS, KILOMETERS, MILES, MILLISECONDS,
                                    SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS)
  -h, --help                        display help for command
